title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's Development Finance Institution. We aim to be a best-in-class impact investor by making commercial private sector investments that support the green transition, as well as building just and inclusive societies in developing countries and emerging markets. Impact Fund Denmark has a strong focus on creating sustainable and responsible businesses, which generate measurable social, economic, and climate impacts as well as solid financial returns.

 

Ready to build the financial engine behind global impact?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

 

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

 

Here is what you get with us:

  • A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development

  • Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team

  • The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:

  • Platform development: design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application

  • Web application development: design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs

  • Dynamics 365 configuration: configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence

  • Process automation: build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems

  • Backlog delivery: work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release

  • Requirements translation: engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs

  • Collaboration with external resources: coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase

  • Testing and release: support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation

  • Production support: troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use

  • Documentation: maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

 

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Technical foundation: have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Platform expertise: have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate

  • Web development skills: have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code

  • Dynamics 365 knowledge: understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles

  • Collaborative delivery: are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers

  • Communication: communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments

  • Problem-solving: take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application

  • Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform

  • Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications

  • Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus

  • Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:

  • Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)

  • Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)

  • Microsoft Power Automate

  • JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development

  • Dynamics 365 as a platform (excluding functionality requiring a Dynamics 365 Sales licence)

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system

  • Azure DevOps for backlog, source control, and release management

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

Ready to build the backbone of our investment, risk and finance operations?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: General worker Pick & Pack
description:

Newrest is looking for General Workers in our Pick & Pack department who will be responsible for putting together the food trolleys for our airline client.   • Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labelled and returned in the dry storage, cooler or packaging material storage.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

  • Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Load airline equipment with trays, dishes, utensils, and containers according to specifications provided.

  • Handle airline equipment and dispose of items in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

  • Complete packing production of items assigned by supervisor or manager.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable requirements related to product and service quality, environmental standards, food safety, and health and safety regulations.

  • Promote a safe and healthy work environment by preventing work-related injuries and illnesses, eliminating hazards, and reducing health and safety risks.

  • Compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP)/General manufacturing practices (GMP) guidelines for personal hygiene and observe security precautions as mandated by unit management.

  • Satisfactory and punctual attendance are expected.

Qualifications:

  • Ability to lift items/packages (up to 30 lbs)

  • Team oriented

  • Ability to handle pressure in a fast paced environment

  • Attendance, diligence, punctuality, reliability

  • Good work ethic

  • Ability to work any shift depending on operational needs.

title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

Otsime hooldustöötajaid, kes soovivad pakkuda hoolt ja tuge meie elanikele Kastre kodus, asukohaga Kastre külas Tartumaal.

Tööülesanded: Milline on sinu roll meie kodudes?
✨ Päeva rõõmuks ja toetuseks: Sa hooldad ja juhendad meie kliente, olles nende jaoks igapäevane tugi ja abiline. ✨ Hoolivus igas pisidetailis: Abistad kliente hügieenitoimingutel, aidates neil säilitada väärikust ja enesekindlust. ✨ Südamega igas hetkes: Toetad meie kliente söömisel ja riietumisel, muutes nende päeva lihtsamaks ja mugavamaks. ✨ Puhtus, mis loob turvatunde: Hoolitsed klientide tubade ja hügieeniruumide puhtuse eest, luues neile mõnusa ja hubase keskkonna. ✨ Tervise hoidmine igas sammus: Tagad hooldus- ja põetusvahendite puhtuse, et meie kliendid saaksid parimat võimalikku hoolt. Kui sinu südames on koht hoolivusele ja soov muuta kellegi päev paremaks, siis ootame sind oma kollektiivi!

Omalt poolt pakume: Meile on oluline, et tunneksid end väärtustatuna. Meie juures ootab sind:
✨ 30 päeva põhipuhkust, et sul oleks aega päriselt puhata. ✨ Sõidukompensatsioon tööle ja koju, kui kasutad isiklikku autot. ✨ Mugavad tööriided ja jalanõud meie poolt – sinu turvalisus on tähtis. ✨ Maitsev toitlustus tööpäeva jooksul. ✨ 30% kõrgem öötöö tasu. ✨ Ka öösiti ei jää sa üksi – tööl on alati kaks hooldustöötajat. ✨ Võimalus areneda – pakume erialaseid koolitusi ja oskuste täiendamist. Kui hoolivus, meeskonnavaim ja arenguvõimalused on sulle olulised, siis sobid meie tiimi suurepäraselt!

Muud nõuded: Oled ideaalne kandidaat, kui sind iseloomustavad:
kannatlikkus ja valmisolek kuulata; täpsus ja kohusetundlikkus igapäevastes tegevustes; hea suhtlemisoskus ja positiivne ellusuhtumine; meeskonnatöö oskus, aga ka iseseisev tegutsemine; füüsiline vastupidavus ja stressitaluvus; tähelepanelikkus ja vastutustunne abivajajate heaolu eest Mida ootame sinult? ✅ Soovitavalt hooldaja kutsetunnistus (või valmisolek õppida meie juures) ✅ Sõiduauto olemasolu on suur pluss ✅ Vähemalt põhiharidus ✅ Kehtiv tervisetõend ✅ Tööle valitud kandidaadil palume enne töölepingu sõlmimist esitada karistusregistri väljavõtte, vastavalt hooldekodus töötamise nõuetele.

title: Bartender
description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week

Enamasti on tegemist 1- või 2-toaliste korteritega. Tööülesanded: • Korterite põhjalik ja hoolduskoristus. • Köögi, vannitoa, WC, magamistoa ja teiste eluruumide koristamine. • Rasva, katlakivi ja muu mustuse eemaldamine erinevatelt pindadelt. • Aurupuhasti kasutamine. • Tekstiilipesuri kasutamine. • Professionaalsete puhastusvahendite, sealhulgas happeliste puhastusvahendite kasutamine. • Kvaliteetse lõpptulemuse tagamine ning tähelepanu detailidele. Tingimused: • Enamik koristusi kestab keskmiselt 4–5 tundi. • Vahel on vaja teha ka lühemaid töid kestusega umbes 2–3 tundi. • Töödest teavitame tavaliselt 3–4 päeva ette. • Tööd toimub vastavalt vajadusele mõned korrad kuus. • Töö toimub töövõtulepingu või muu kokkuleppel sõlmitava lepingu alusel. • Tasu kokkuleppel.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Ametlikku koostööd lepingu alusel.
• Võimalust teenida lisaraha põhitöö kõrvalt. • Paindlikku töökorraldust. • Tööde ja tööaja eelnevat kokkuleppimist. • Tavaliselt teavitame töödest 3–4 päeva ette. • Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid ja töövahendid on meie poolt. • Püsivat koostööd kvaliteetse töö korral. • Õigeaegset töötasu. • Sõbralikku ja lugupidavat suhtumist. • Selgeid tööülesandeid ning eelnevalt kokkulepitud töömahtu.

Muud nõuded: • Varasem kogemus korterite või majade koristamisel on kohustuslik.
• Oskus töötada iseseisvalt ja organiseeritult. • Kogemus professionaalsete puhastusvahendite ja seadmete kasutamisel. • Oskus eemaldada keerulisemaid määrdumisi. • Korrektsus, vastutustunne ja täpsus. • Tähelepanu detailidele ning kohusetundlik suhtumine töösse. Oluline: otsime koristajat, kellel on varasem töökogemus koristusvaldkonnas. Ilma kogemuseta kandidaate me kahjuks ei kaalu.

title: Project Engineer, ABB Marine & Ports
description:
We are looking for a motivated Project Engineer to join ABB Marine & Ports and support the delivery of advanced marine electrical, propulsion, and control system projects.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or an early-career engineer who wants to develop technical expertise within a global engineering organization and gain hands-on experience in international delivery projects.

Your responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, you will:

- Support Lead Engineers in delivery project engineering and design activities
- Assist in technical problem-solving throughout the project lifecycle
- Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and related engineering activities
- Prepare and maintain technical documentation
- Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams on system integration and troubleshooting
- Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and ways of working
- Support project teams in ensuring successful project execution and delivery

You will have the opportunity to work with systems such as:

- Generators
- Main switchboards and power distribution systems
- Transformers
- Converters and drives
- Propulsion Control Systems (PCS)
- Remote Control Systems (RCS)
- Dynamic Positioning (DP) systems
- Marine automation and control systems

What we are looking for

To succeed in this role, we hope you have:

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Good written and spoken English communication skills
- Ability to work effectively in an international project environment
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- Interest in electrical systems, automation, and engineering projects

Considered an advantage

- Familiarity with EPLAN or other electrical design tools
- Knowledge of IEC or IEEE standards
- Previous project, internship, or thesis experience related to electrical engineering or automation
- Interest in marine technology and power systems

What we offer

- Opportunity to work with world-leading marine technologies
- Exposure to challenging international delivery projects
- Great opportunities for professional growth and development

Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications and interview suitable candidates during the application period. The position will be filled once a suitable candidate has been found.

Please note that, for GDPR and data security reasons, we are unable to process applications submitted by email or through other channels. To be considered for the position, please submit your application through our recruitment system on our website.

title: Process Engineer (Surface Treatment)
description:
Type: permanent, full-time

Location: Perniö, Turku, Tampere, Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Oulu, remote

Application deadline: 28.9.2026

Want to develop surface treatment processes in an international environment and impact production quality and efficiency? Wipro is looking for a Process Engineer!

**What will you be doing?**

We are looking for a Process Engineer to join Wipro Infrastructure Engineering as a technical expert in surface treatment. You will develop and evaluate new and existing surface treatment methods at Wipros manufacturing sites and support production, R&D, and other teams in technical matters. Your work will focus especially on industrial painting and pretreatment processes, corrosion testing, and improving process quality and efficiency.

Your projects may include reducing paint and energy use, improving cycle times, and finding more environmentally friendly solutions. You will also support equipment investments by defining technical requirements and taking part in testing and commissioning. In addition, you will help investigate production issues, support the technical handling of customer complaints, and work with customers, suppliers, and Wipro teams at the manufacturing sites in Perniö, Sweden, and Romania.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have a strong practical and technical understanding of industrial surface treatment processes and experience in developing them. You understand not only individual process steps but also the whole process and how different changes can affect quality, costs, efficiency, and production. You are interested in improving processes and finding better technical solutions.

This is an independent and international role, so we value an accurate, organized, and proactive way of working as well as good communication and negotiation skills. Working with different teams, suppliers, and customers comes naturally to you, and you can adapt to changing situations. A practical and cost-conscious approach will help you succeed in this role.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant technical degree, for example in chemical, materials, process, production, or mechanical engineering

- Several years of relevant experience in industrial surface treatment and process development

- Strong knowledge of industrial painting and pretreatment processes, as well as electrolytic surface treatment methods

- Experience with AutoCAD and/or other technical design tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, or similar software

- Good English skills and willingness to travel to Wipros sites within Europe


**Additionally valued:**

- Experience with different surface treatment methods, such as nitrocarburizing or chromium processes

- Experience with equipment investments, commissioning, or technical development projects

- Knowledge of surface treatment testing, process requirements, or quality development


**Wipro offers you:**

- The freedom to develop surface treatment processes and make a real impact on quality, efficiency, and sustainability

- An international environment where you work across manufacturing sites and develop your technical skills

- The opportunity to develop new solutions and help shape the future of surface treatment at Wipro

- A varied expert role combining technical development, projects, and practical problem-solving

- The flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible, depending on your notice period.

You can work either at Wipros Perniö site or remotely from anywhere in Finland. The position includes approximately 50–60 travel days per year, mainly to Wipros sites in Finland, Sweden, and Romania. Salary in this position is 4500-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**How to apply?**

Please submit your CV and application in PDF format in English by Monday 28th of September via aTalents application system: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/382498/create/ .

Remember to use the application system as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure an equal recruitment process for all applicants and will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can learn more about Wipro Infrastructure Engineering here: https://hydraulics.wiproinfra.com/.

For more information about the position and recruitment process, please contact aTalents Recruitment Consultant Säde Juntunen (+358 44 901 2283, sade.juntunen@atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

**Company description**

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy develops, manufactures, and markets high-quality hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic components under the Nummi trademark. The company is also a well-known OEM manufacturer of double-acting hydraulic cylinders. Wipro operates internationally, and about 70% of its turnover comes from exports. In addition to Finland, its main markets are Scandinavia, Poland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Switzerland._

_Wipro Infrastructure Engineering Oy is a subsidiary of the Indian company Wipro Enterprises. Its parent company, Wipro Ltd, is an international multi-business corporation listed on the New York and Mumbai stock exchanges. The company is headquartered in Bangalore, India. Wipro Infrastructure Engineering has manufacturing facilities in Finland (Perniö), Sweden, Romania, Brazil, India, Canada, and the United States._

title: Auton fiksaus ja korjaus
description:
Monipuolinen autoalan työntekijä / autopesulan työntekijä

Etsimme yritykseemme monipuolista ja motivoitunutta autoalan työntekijää. Yrityksemme tarjoaa auton pesu-, puhdistus- ja viimeistelypalveluita sekä teemme tarpeen mukaan erilaisia autojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on käytännön kokemusta useista autoalan työtehtävistä ja joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti sekä huolellisesti.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu esimerkiksi:

Vähän ymmärrystä sähköautoista.

\* autojen ulkopesu ja perusteellinen puhdistus

\* autojen sisäpuhdistus ja detailing

\* auton maalipinnan kiillotus ja myllytys

\* maalipinnan viimeistely ja mahdolliset pienet maalaustyöt

\* auton korin ja maalipinnan käsittely

\* autojen perustason huolto- ja korjaustyöt

\* moottorin ja auton teknisen toiminnan ymmärtäminen

\* auton vianmäärityksen avustavat tehtävät

\* moottorin toimintaan ja optimointiin liittyvien asioiden ymmärtäminen

\* muut autopesulan ja autokorjaamon päivittäiset tehtävät.

Edellytämme hakijalta:

\* aikaisempaa työkokemusta autoalalta

\* käytännön osaamista auton pesusta, puhdistuksesta ja kiillotuksesta

\* ymmärrystä autojen rakenteesta ja tekniikasta

\* huolellista ja vastuullista työotetta

\* kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

\* hyvää motivaatiota oppia uusia työtehtäviä

\* valmiutta tehdä monipuolisia autoalan työtehtäviä.

Eduksi katsotaan erityisesti se, että hakijalla on kokemusta sekä autonhoidosta että autojen teknisistä korjaus- ja huoltotehtävistä. Arvostamme henkilöä, joka ymmärtää auton kokonaisuutena eikä ainoastaan autonpesua.

Työ on käytännönläheistä ja työtehtävät vaihtelevat asiakkaiden ja yrityksen tarpeiden mukaan. Sopiva henkilö voi osallistua myös yrityksen toiminnan kehittämiseen ja uusiin autoalan palveluihin.

Kielitaito: suomen kielen osaaminen katsotaan eduksi. Muu kielitaito ei ole este, mikäli hakijalla on tehtävään vaadittava ammatillinen osaaminen.

Työsuhde: kokoaikainen / määräaikainen tai toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde sovittavasta järjestelystä riippuen.

Haemme ennen kaikkea monipuolista autoalan ammattilaista, jolla on käytännön osaamista, työmoraalia ja halua kehittyä.

title: Huoltoasentaja
description:
Työssäsi huoltoasentajana keskityt pumppujen (sähkö)mekaanisiin huolto-, korjaus- ja asennustöihin sekä erilaisissa asiakaskohteissa että Flowplus Oy:n omalla palvelukeskuksella Seinäjoella. Lisäksi työhön kuuluvat muut avustavat työt työmaalla ja laitteiden valmistelu- ja korjaustyöt verstaalla. Työ sisältää matkustamista myös muualle kotimaahan sekä tarvittaessa ulkomaille.

Työsuhteesi on kokopäiväinen ja vakituinen. Viikoittainen työaikasi on 37,5 h ja työskentelet arkisin klo 8.00-16.00, mutta toivomme sinulta joustavuutta, sillä asiakaskohteissa työpäivät voivat toisinaan venyä. Flowplus Oy:lle on tärkeää, että työt hoidetaan kunnialla loppuun ja työnkuvasi edellyttääkin itsenäistä työotetta, asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä, vastuunkantoa ja tiimityötaitoja.

Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen, monipuolisen työnkuvan vaihtelevissa työkohteissa sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kykyjesi mukaan. Pääset jo vahvaan moniosaajien tiimiin, joka toimii tukenasi.

Työsuhteessasi sovelletaan Teknologiateollisuuden TES:iä ja palkkaus on sopimuksen mukaan.

Työsopimuksen aloitusaika sopimuksen mukaan.

Toivomme sinulta:

- monipuolista kokemusta kunnossapidosta tai sähkö- ja automaatiotyöstä

- valmiutta matkatöihin

- sopeutumiskykyä eri työkohteiden vaihteleviin olosuhteisiin ja joustoa työaikoihin kiireaikoina sekä projektien toteutuksessa

- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä


Eduksi katsomme:

- C1-ajokortti

- sähköpätevyys S2

- sähkö- ja automaatioalan peruskoulutus


Eduksi katsomme myös koulutukset:

- työturvallisuuskortti

- tulityöturvakortti

- sähkötyöturvallisuuskoulutukset


Tarjoamme sinulle: Flowplus Oy tarjoaa sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen kasvavassa ja vakavaraisessa yhtiössä, jossa saat kattavan perehdytyksen sekä ammattitaitoiset kollegat. Flowplussalla pääset kehittymään ammatillisesti vaihtelevissa työkohteissa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen. Panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja käytössäsi ovatkin kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten ePassi, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, työsuhdepyörä sekä mahdollisuus liittyä sairauskassaan. Flowplussalla työnjälkesi näkyy ja sitä arvostetaan!

title: Myyntilupakoordinaattori
description:
Myyntiluvat-vastuualueen Regulatoriset prosessit -yksikössä koordinoidaan kansallisia ja kansainvälisiä lääkevalmisteiden myyntilupahakemuksia ja niiden muutoksia.

Myyntilupakoordinaattorin pääasiallisena tehtävänä on keskitetyn menettelyn myyntilupahakemusten käsittelyyn liittyvät hallinnolliset tehtävät ja myyntilupahakemuksiin liittyvistä prosesseista vastaaminen moniammatillisen tiimin jäsenenä.

Tehtävät koostuvat monipuolisista vastuutehtävistä kuten hakemuskäsittelyn koordinointi, hakemustilanteen raportointi sekä yhteydenpito Euroopan lääkevirastoon ja muihin EU:n lääkeviranomaisiin.

Tästä hausta voidaan täyttää myös mahdollisia määräaikaisia myyntilupakoordinaattorin virkasuhteita.

Toteutamme rekrytoinnin anonyymisti edistääksemme yhdenmukaista ja tasa-arvoista rekrytointia. Valitsemme hakijat haastatteluun ilman tietoa hakijan nimestä, iästä, sukupuolesta, paikkakunnasta (kaikki yhteystiedot), äidinkielestä, kansallisuudesta tai hakijan ulkonäöstä. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin vuoksi toivomme hakemukset ensisijaisesti sähköisessä muodossa valtiolle.fi kautta. Vältäthän myös henkilötietojesi kirjaamista hakemuksen avoimissa tekstikentissä. Mikäli kysyt puhelimitse lisätietoja tehtävästä, vältäthän kertomasta itsestäsi tietoja, jotka vaarantavat anonyymiyden. Emme vastaanota liitetiedostoja.

title: Country HR Manager
description:
_Walki transforms materials for a circular future and towards a sustainable society by extending products' life cycle and embracing resource efficiency. We are an industry leading advanced materials conversion specialist delivering transformative, sustainable solutions to solve the most demanding challenges in packaging and the built environment. Walki is a growing international group organized in three business areas: Consumer Packaging, Packaging Materials and Engineered Materials, with operations in eleven different countries, both in Europe and Asia. In 2025, the Group's annual turnover was approx. 599 million euros employing around 1600 people._

**We are looking for an experienced Country HR Manager for Walki!**

**Your role**

In this comprehensive role, you will be responsible for the entire HR function in Finland, harmonizing processes and implementing global guidelines locally. You will lead a team of HR specialists and oversee HR operations across Walki's Finnish sites, ensuring high-quality support for managers and employees while continuously developing HR practices. Beyond strategic vision, the role also calls for a pragmatic and hands-on approach supporting the business and driving HR initiatives into practice. The position can be based in Valkeakoski, Säkylä, or Pietarsaari. Walki's sites are located along the Pietarsaari-Espoo axis.

You bring strong expertise in managing the full employee lifecycle and HR processes in an industrial or manufacturing environment. You will serve as a trusted partner to site and business leaders and help supervisors succeed in their roles. Working closely with Finance and other Group functions, you will contribute to workforce planning, payroll budgeting, and people-related decision-making. In addition, you will ensure that local compensation, benefits, payroll, and HR administration practices support both compliance requirements and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is down-to-earth, collaborative, and flexible. You lead by example and act as a role model in teamwork, interaction, and communication. Safety is a core part of Walki's culture and production environment. While Walki has a separate safety organization, HR plays an important role in supporting and driving the safety culture through example. You are able to see the bigger picture while breaking it down into practical steps, building functional processes and ways of working, and putting them into practice.

**What we offer**

At Walki, you will join a highly skilled HR team. At Walki, you will work in an international organisation with a collaborative, low-hierarchy culture where people are approachable, business-focused, and committed to continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in developing HR practices and supporting leaders in a growing international organisation. Walki offers a hybrid work model with up to 50 % remote work, as well as a culture benefit.

**We hope our future Country HR Manager has the following qualities and skills:**

- At least five years of experience in HR Manager-level roles in an industrial environment

- Borad experience in managing HR processes across the employee lifecycle and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of collective agreements (experience with the paper or chemical industry collective agreements is considered a particular advantage)

- Experience implementing and harmonizing HR practices in a multi-site or international organisation. Experience and understanding of how, for example, M&A and integration processes affect HR's scope of work is considered an asset.

- Solid knowledge of employment legislation, statutory documentation, and local negotiations, along with a track record in co-operation procedures

- Ability to navigate a complex stakeholder environment involving multiple sites, collective agreements, and cross-functional collaboration within a group structure. You understand the demands of a matrix organization and corporate group structure.

- Excellent leadership and people management skills

- Fluent Finnish and English. Swedish language skills are an advantage.

- Compensation & benefits expertise is considered an advantage


While we are looking for an experienced HR professional, we also value curiosity, continuous learning, and a willingness to challenge established ways of working when opportunities for improvement exist. What matters is recognizing what you don't yet know and knowing how to find the right answers.

**Recruitment process**

We'd love to hear from you next! Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. The application period closes on 30 September 2026, but applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The recruitment process is managed by Jasmiina Inkinen at Valiant HR Oy (tel. 050 557 4696), who is happy to answer any questions. You can also reach Jasmiina by email at jasmiina@valianthr.fi.

First-round interviews are tentatively scheduled for weeks 40–41, with follow-up interviews in weeks 41–42. The first interview round will take place on Teams.

This recruitment is carried out in partnership with Valiant HR Oy. The successful candidate will be employed directly by Walki.

_About Valiant HR Oy:_

_Valiant HR Oy is a recruitment partner that understands both business and people. We specialize in recruitment and executive search for office, manager, and executive-level roles. Delivering a positive experience for both clients and candidates is at the heart of what we do. Learn more about us and how we work: www.valianthr.fi_

title: Talotekniikan asiantuntija etähallintakeskukseemme
description:
ISS Operations Performance -yksikkö tukee vahvasti ISS:n strategian toteutusta ja liiketoiminnallista suorituskykyä eli vie meitä yrityksenä kohti tulevaisuuden kannattavaa kasvua. Operations Performancella on neljä keskeistä tehtävää: se kehittää yhtiömme tuottavuutta, tuotteiden kilpailukykyä ja toimintamme hintakilpailukykyä sekä vastaa muutosjohtamisesta merkittävissä projekteissa. Jälkimmäiseen kuuluu myös asiakaslupauksen mukaisten haltuunottojen varmistaminen. Operations Performance on keskeinen elementti OneISS-strategiassa: se osaltaan tekee meistä vahvemman, selkeämmän ja tiiviimmän yrityksen.



Haemme nyt asiakaspalveluhenkistä TALOTEKNIIKAN ASIANTUNTIJAA, ISS Remote Engineering Centre-etähallintakeskukseemme Kuopioon. Kyseessä on kokopäiväinen, toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä, jossa työtä tehdään katkeamattomana vuorotyönä arkisin ja viikonloppuisin 12h vuoroissa. Etähallintakeskus toimii asiakkaidemme tukena 24/7 eli ympärivuorokautisesti, vuoden jokaisena päivänä.
Talotekniikan asiantuntijana vastaat kiinteistöjen taloteknisiin järjestelmiin, rakennusautomaatioon ja muihin etähallittaviin järjestelmiin liittyvistä monipuolisista työtehtävistä sekä raportoinnista. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kriittisissä ympäristöissä toimivien asiakkaidemme kanssa sekä sähköpostitse ja puhelimitse. Toimit asiakkaiden asiantuntevana kumppanina löytäen heidän liiketoimintaansa tukevia ratkaisuja eri kiinteistöpalveluistamme. Vastaat asiakkaiden prosessien toiminnasta sekä kiinteistöjen energia- ja olosuhdehallinnasta.
Odotamme sinulta aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistöautomaation- sekä talotekniikan parista. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tekniikan alalta, kuten talo-, sähkö-, energia- tai automaatiotekniikan tutkinto. Voit olla opintojesi loppuvaiheessa oleva tulevaisuuden kyky tai jo kokemusta omaava ammattilainen. Tehtävässä menestymisen edellytyksenä on motivaatio ja aito halu toimia rohkeasti asiakasrajapinnassa. Arvostamme automaatiojärjestelmien syvällistä tuntemusta sekä ymmärrystä kiinteistöjen olosuhteista ja energiankulutuksesta. Työssäsi tarvitset oma-aloitteisuutta, vahvaa palveluasennetta sekä paineensietokykyä. Viestit sujuvasti ja selkeästi, niin suullisesti kuin kirjallisesti, suomen kielellä. Lisäksi sinulla on hyvä englannin kielen taito ja IT-taitosi ovat ajan tasalla. Teetämme valitulle henkilölle turvallisuusselvityksen, joka on hyväksyttynä edellytys työsopimukselle.
Tarjoamme sinulle perehdytyksen itsenäiseen, mielenkiintoiseen ja haastavaan työhön asiantuntijayksikössämme. Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kannustavaan tiimiimme! Tarjoamme myös mahdollisuuksia kehittyä ja kasvaa. Tule kanssamme luomaan tiloja, joissa on hyvä olla!
Mikäli olet etsimämme henkilö, jätä meille hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 27.9.2026. Liitäthän hakemukseesi mukaan myös CV:si. Olemme sinuun pian yhteydessä!


ISS työllistää Suomessa lähes 1000 teknistä ammattilaista asentajista erilaisiin kiinteistötekniikan asiantuntijoihin ja päälliköihin. ISS:llä tekniset osaajat pitävät huolta siitä, että kriittiset tilat toimivat – datakeskuksista tehtaisiin ja sairaaloihin. Tärkeissä paikoissa tarvitaan taitavimmat tekijät, jotka haluavat ratkoa haasteita aidosti monipuolisessa ympäristössä. Tarjoamme tilaa itsenäisyydelle, vastuuta, monipuolisia urapolkuja ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Tutustu teknisiin ammattilaisiimme täällä: ISS työpaikat - Työ teknisissä palveluissa

title: Huoltoneuvoja / Työnjohtaja
description:
Huoltoneuvojana olet tärkeä linkki asiakkaan ja korjaamon välillä. Vastaat asiakaspalvelusta ja huoltoprosessin sujuvuudesta alusta loppuun.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat esimerkiksi:

· asiakkaiden vastaanotto ja asiakaspalvelu

· huoltojen ajanvaraus ja työmääräysten laatiminen

· korjaustöiden suunnittelu ja työnjohto

· varaosien tilaaminen

· yhteydenpito asiakkaisiin huollon aikana

· huoltojen valmistumisen ja laadun varmistaminen sekä laskutus

· yhteistyö asentajien ja muun tiimin kanssa

**Toivomme sinulta**

Olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ja pidät langat käsissäsi myös kiireessä.

Lisäksi odotamme sinulta:

· kokemusta huoltoneuvojan tai korjaamon asiakaspalvelutehtävistä

· monimerkkiautojen tuntemusta

· sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä kykyä palvella asiakkaita myös englanniksi

· hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

· positiivista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

· joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä

· soveltuvaa koulutusta tai vastaavaa työkokemusta

Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen seuraavista järjestelmistä:

· FuturSoft

· Partslink

· Autodata

· Boschin testauslaitteet ja -ohjelmistot

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

· vakituisen työn kasvavassa ja vakavaraisessa yrityksessä

· monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

· kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisesi mukaan

· ammattitaitoisen, kannustavan ja hyvän työilmapiirin

· modernit työvälineet ja laadukkaat korjaamojärjestelmät

· mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi

Meillä pääset työskentelemään yrityksessä, jossa henkilöstön ammattitaitoa arvostetaan ja onnistumisia tehdään yhdessä.

title: Koirasafariopas Leville
description:
KOKENEITA KOIRASAFARIOPPAITA LEVILLE!

Etsimme kahta kokenutta koirasafariopasta osaksi vauhdikasta ja hyvähenkistä talvisesonkia Levillä!

Jos tunnet olosi kotoisaksi sekä koirien että ihmisten seurassa, viihdyt Lapin luonnossa ja sinulla on kokemusta safarien vetämisestä, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.


MITÄ TYÖ PITÄÄ SISÄLLÄÄN?

Koirasafarioppaana vastaat asiakkaiden turvallisesta ja onnistuneesta safari-elämyksestä sekä koirien hyvinvoinnista. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa:

* koirasafareiden itsenäinen vetäminen

* koirien päivittäinen huolto ja hyvinvoinnista huolehtiminen

* päivärutiinien ja aikataulujen hallinta

* asiakkaiden ohjaaminen ja opastaminen

* turvallisuusohjeiden tarkka noudattaminen

* luonnossa ja talvisissa olosuhteissa liikkuminen

* yhteistyö muun työyhteisön kanssa


MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme kokenutta ja luotettavaa opasta, jolla on:

* aikaisempaa kokemusta koirasafareiden vetämisestä

* hyvä ymmärrys päivittäisistä rutiineista ja aikatauluista safarioppaana

* suomen tai englannin kielen taito

* muiden kielten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi

* rauhallinen ja vastuullinen ote safarien ohjaamiseen

* tarkkuutta turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamisessa

* joustavuutta ja positiivista asennetta

* hyvä fyysinen toimintakyky ja luonteva tapa liikkua luonnossa

Ennen kaikkea toivomme, että tulet hyvin toimeen koirien ja ihmisten kanssa. Arvostamme opasta, joka osaa pitää tilanteet rauhallisina, huomioi asiakkaat ja koirat, sekä nauttit Lapin luonnosta.


MITÄ TARJOAMME?

* Työt voidaan aloittaa heti

* Työsuhde kestää sesongin loppuun

* Tarjolla on täydet työtunnit, mutta myös pienemmät tuntitakuut ovat mahdollisia

* Majoitus voidaan järjestää läheltä työpaikkaa

* Palkkaus ohjelmapalvelualan TES** mukaan tai osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella**

* Mahdollisuus tehdä työtä, jossa Lapin luonto, koirat ja ihmiset kohtaavat joka päivä


KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos olet kokenut koirasafariopas ja haluat viettää loppusesongin Lapissa koirien, asiakkaiden ja upeiden maisemien parissa, laita meille viestiä ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi sekä aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi.

Paikkoja avoinna: 2

Levi, Kittilä
Koirasafariopas
Aloitus: heti
Kesto: sesongin loppuun

title: Manufacturing Data Engineer, Bluefors Oy
description:
Do you want to help develop product data management and change management processes in one of the world's leading quantum technology companies?

We are looking for a Manufacturing Data Engineer to join our client Bluefors Oy's Manufacturing Engineering team. In this role, you will work at the interface of engineering, production, and product data management, ensuring that product structures, revisions, and technical data are maintained accurately and released to production in a controlled manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with technical data, systems, and processes while collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing teams in a growing high-tech environment.

Job Description

As a Manufacturing Data Engineer, you will be responsible for maintaining and managing product data while supporting change management processes across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Creating, maintaining, and managing Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Maintaining product data in ERP and PLM systems
- Supporting and coordinating engineering change processes (ECO/ECM)
- Managing the release and scheduling of revisions and engineering changes
- Ensuring data consistency between ERP and PLM systems
- Collaborating closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Change Management teams
- Supporting product data quality and continuous process improvement
- Assisting the Manufacturing Engineering team with product data management related activities

We Expect You To Have

- A relevant technical degree
- A few years of relevant work experience in a manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working with ERP and PLM/PDM systems (Experience with Lean ERP is considered an advantage)
- Experience managing and maintaining Bills of Materials (BOMs)
- Understanding of engineering change management processes (ECO/ECM) and product lifecycle management
- Strong English communication skills, as English is the primary working language
- A structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working
- Good collaboration and communication skills

We Offer

- An opportunity to work for a global leader in quantum technology
- A key role at the intersection of Manufacturing Engineering and Product Data Management
- A supportive and highly skilled team environment
- A thorough onboarding process
- Opportunities to grow your responsibilities and develop professionally
- Flexible working hours
- Partial remote work possibilities depending on business needs
- A modern and international working environment

At Bluefors, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of scalable processes in a rapidly growing organization while building expertise in product lifecycle and manufacturing data management.

Interested?

Submit your application as soon as possible, as interviews will be conducted during the application period and the position will be filled once a suitable candidate is found.

Please note that, for security reasons, we cannot process applications submitted via email.

title: Commissioning Engineer (smelting)
description:
On behalf of our customer, we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer with previous work experience related to smelting plants. Headquartered in Espoo, Finland, our customer is providing sustainable technology, equipment, and services for the aggregates, minerals processing, and metals refining industries This position offers a vantage point in the company's deliveries within metals refining and opportunity for you to travel the world. You will take part in the construction, installation and start-up of a new scrap copper smelting plant in Gujarat, India. This is a long-term international assignment, expected to last at least one year, with the possibility of periodic trips home during the assignment. Accommodation and local transportation will, in most cases, be arranged by the customer.


Your responsibilities will include:

- Supervise and coordinate installation and commissioning activities.

- Work closely with the customer, employees, subcontractors and other stakeholders.

- Monitor progress, quality and site activities.

- Support problem-solving during installation and start-up.

- Ensure that work is carried out safely and according to project requirements.

- Coordinate activities between different disciplines when required.

- Report progress and identify potential issues to the project management team.

- Participate in commissioning, testing and start-up activities.

- Act as a practical link between the project team and the site.

What we expect from you:

The technical requirements are relatively broad. The most important qualification is practical experience from a smelting or metallurgical plant environment.

Your background may be in e.g.:

- Mechanical installation and maintenance

- Electrical systems and installation

- Automation and instrumentation

- Production operations

- Maintenance

- Site supervision or commissioning

You do not necessarily need to have a specific engineering background. Relevant hands-on experience in a smelting environment and the ability to take responsibility on site are the key requirements.

- Previous experience in a smelting / metallurgical plant environment is essential.

- Experience in at least one of the following areas: mechanical, electrical, automation, production or maintenance.

- Practical, hands-on approach and ability to work independently.

- Good communication and coordination skills.

- Experience working with customers, employees and subcontractors is an advantage.

- Good command of spoken and written English.

- Willingness to work on an international assignment in India for an extended period.

- Ability to adapt to a multicultural and international working environment.

- An international, English-speaking candidate is preferred, as the role involves close cooperation with an international project organization and customer.


We offer you:

- a great opportunity and vantage point to participating in the ongoing delivery of world-leading technology supplier.

- an opportunity to leave your own mark as member of the site commissioning team while adding a strong reference in your competence portfolio.

- an exciting role contributing to latest smelting technology and sustainability.

- a competitive and encouraging salary closely mirroring your performance.

- opportunity to travel and experience the world in additon to working.

- an opportunity to meet and work with people globally.

The job will start as soon as the right candidate have been selected. Duration is a fixed 12 months. The assignment is also suitable for freelance entrepreneurs part of our supplier network.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV ASAP as we are interviewing candidates as they come in!


ECHO Engineering

Echo Engineering Oy (www.echoengineering.fi) was established in 2019 to respond to the fluctuating demand for assignment-based technical professionals in the technology industry. For our parent company, Kaiku HR, this direction is a natural step towards offering a more comprehensive skill palette for the clients. To chosen clients we not only offer local technical consulting services, but also flexible remote design capacity out of India or bring technical experts to Finland for long-term assignments. Combining our capabilities, we can offer services that correspond to the high Finnish quality standards in a competitive price range. Our key personnel have over 20 years of experience in the field: Mats Lindholms expertise lies in selling services of local hour based freelance engineers, recruiting, and acting as an agent.
