Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation. Jouer un rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes d'ingénierie, d'exploitation, de delivery, d'avant-vente et des clients, afin de sécuriser les choix techniques et de favoriser l'adoption des solutions définies. Assurer une veille technologique active et proposer des évolutions pertinentes sur les services OVH, Clever Cloud, les technologies cloud native et les approches d'automatisation afin d'enrichir les offres et les plateformes de DEEP. Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Votre profil Disposer d'une formation de niveau Master spécialisée en informatique, systèmes, réseaux et cloud, et/ou d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.


What you will be working on:

Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.


What we look for:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

Employment Type: Permanent

Join our team as an AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager, where you'll play a key role in managing risk and valuations for alternative investment funds like private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. You'll work with advanced risk models, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, and support clients in setting up funds. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

As a vital team member and in return for your expertise, inclusive approach and commitment, we'll provide a favourable salary and the chance to join a passionate and welcoming team. title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

General information:

• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research scientist
• Job Reference: UOL08342

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

Identify inefficiencies in current workflows and lead initiatives to standardize processes, minimize manual tasks, and improve alignment across business functions.

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

title: IT Senior Consultant - Internal Audit (m/f)
description:
IT Senior Consultant - Internal Audit

Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100150

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Our Internal Audit practice supports leading financial institutions in Luxembourg in strengthening their IT governance, internal control frameworks, and digital risk management capabilities.

Within a fast-evolving regulatory and technological environment, we assist Boards, Authorized Management, CIOs, CISOs, and Heads of Internal Audit in addressing regulatory expectations, enhancing operational resilience, and managing technology-related risks.
Join a dynamic and growing practice where innovation, collaboration, and professional excellence drive our ambition to become a leading Consulting & Advisory player in Luxembourg.

Your role:

As an IT Senior Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering IT Internal Audit engagements across the Luxembourg financial sector.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading and executing IT Internal Audit engagements covering IT General Controls (ITGC), application controls, IT governance, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.
• Supporting financial institutions (banks, asset managers, ManCos, AIFMs, payment institutions, PSFs) in strengthening their IT control environment and internal audit functions.
• Assessing compliance with Luxembourg and European regulatory frameworks including CSSF circulars, DORA, EBA Guidelines, ICT Risk Management and outsourcing regulations.
• Performing IT risk assessments, control design reviews, testing activities, maturity assessments, and remediation follow-ups.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to clients by translating complex IT risks into pragmatic business recommendations.
• Managing day-to-day delivery of engagements, monitoring timelines, and ensuring high-quality outputs.
• Contributing to the development of Internal Audit methodologies and innovative service solutions.
• Coaching and mentoring junior consultants while fostering a collaborative team environment.
• Supporting business development initiatives through proposal preparation, client presentations, and market eminence activities.
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across Risk Advisory, Cybersecurity and Regulatory Consulting practices.

Your profile:

• Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
• A maximum of 3 to 4 years of professional experience in IT Internal Audit, IT Risk Advisory, Technology Consulting, or External/Internal Audit, gained within a consulting firm or financial institution.
• Strong knowledge of IT control frameworks and standards such as COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST, COSO, and ITIL.
• Good understanding of Luxembourg regulatory expectations impacting IT environments (CSSF, DORA, ICT risk, outsourcing, operational resilience). PSD2 may be an added advantage.
• Ability to interact confidently with senior stakeholders including CIO, CISO, Internal Audit and Risk functions.
• Strong analytical mindset combined with business acumen and consulting attitude.
• Proven project coordination and team mentoring capabilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Fluency in English is mandatory; French and/or German are strong assets.

We offer:

• Exposure to tier-1 financial institutions and complex IT risk environments in Luxembourg.
• A strong focus on personal development and professional growth, including continuous learning environment with structured training programs and certification support (CISA, CIA, CRISC, ISO 27001, CISSP).
• A dynamic, multicultural, and collaborative work environment with competitive remuneration and benefits.
• The advantages of working in a human-sized international firm that combines professional excellence with a commitment to societal impact as well as global reach with a personal and collaborative working culture.
• A young, energetic, and supportive team culture where your contribution is valued, and where you can make a tangible difference for both clients and the firm.
• The opportunity to contribute to international projects or work with cross-border teams, while your base will be in Luxembourg.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

description:
Policy Administration Officer - CDD 12 months

Partner & Client Services - Findel, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg

About Utmost International

Utmost International is a leading provider of insurance-based wealth solutions operating across the UK, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and the Middle East. Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

About Utmost Luxembourg S.A.

Sitting at the crossroads of private banking, asset management, and insurance, we operate in a well-established and fast-growing division of the financial services industry. Our dynamic international team of 450+ experienced wealth structuring specialists, subject-matter and technical experts consists of 50 different nationalities, speaking over 30 languages.

We are a diverse and inclusive organisation driven by a values-based culture that promotes excellence, ambition, and innovation. We invest in talented teams who develop their expertise, curated through support and training, and fostered through a people centred culture. Our people truly are our greatest asset!

Your role – Are you ready for a challenge?

As Policy Administration Officer, you will support the end-to-end management of client payment requests and ensure a high-quality service to clients, partners, and internal teams. You will play a key role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency in day-to-day operational activities. Your attention to detail and client-centric approach will help maintain our high standards of service and compliance.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Manage client money-out requests from receipt to payment,
(acknowledgement, documentation collection, system input, etc.),
• Conduct due diligence reviews in line with corporate standard to ensure AML/KYC reviews and updates where required,
• Comply with procedures, controls, industry rules and regulations,
• Monitor ongoing transactions until completion and payment,
• Respond to client and partner queries via email and other channels swiftly and accurately to help achieve customer satisfaction as well as service standards,
• Prepare, scan, send confirmation letters and other necessary communication,
• Perform servicing and maintenance tasks on policies,
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate processing,
• Assist colleagues with daily tasks and contribute to continuous process improvement,
• Meet Service Level Agreements and deadlines,
• Uphold quality standards.

Your profile – Have you got what it takes to become our Policy Administration Officer?

• University Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Management or any other relevant field and/or relevant experience in Client Services/ Policy Administration in the insurance sector,
• Previous experience in life insurance, banking, financial services, or operations is an asset,
• Fluency in English. Any other European language is an asset,
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy,
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills,
• Knowledge of AML / KYC requirements preferred,
• Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks,
• Team-player with a proactive and flexible mindset,
• Proficient in Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Given the sensitive nature of our business, industry sector and the role as described, the selected candidate is required to provide a criminal record (Bulletin n°3 for Luxembourgish residents). This excerpt will be kept by Utmost Luxembourg S.A. in compliance with article 8-5 (2) of the law of 23 July 2016 and for no longer than one month from the conclusion of the employment contract; otherwise, it will be destroyed without any undue delay should the candidate not be hired.

title: Chef de Rang (m/f)
description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

Autres avantages:  Parking, Repas.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

title: GIO - Application Administrator / Support Engineer (m/f)
description:
We are looking for an Application Administrator / Support Engineer to take ownership of our business systems and provide second-level support to users across the organization. You will configure and maintain business applications, resolve escalated support issues, manage user access, build reports and automations, and ensure our tools run smoothly as we grow.


This role offers growth opportunities with hands-on experience in system integrations, automation, and technical operations. You will start as a power user and develop into a technical administrator who builds workflows and connects systems.


Responsibilities
Second-Level Support :

    Handle escalated support tickets requiring deeper technical investigation.

    Diagnose and resolve complex application issues across business systems.

    Communicate solutions clearly to users in French, English, and German.

    Document recurring issues and create knowledge base articles.

    Identify patterns in support requests and address root causes.

User & Access Management :

    Manage user accounts, permissions, and roles across all business applications.

    Own onboarding and offboarding processes for system access.

    Implement and maintain security policies and access controls.

System Configuration :

    Configure applications to match business processes and workflows.

    Build and maintain custom fields, objects, and automation rules.

    Set up and maintain integrations between systems.

Data & Reporting :

    Create and maintain reports and dashboards that support decision-making.

    Ensure data quality and consistency across platforms.

    Handle data imports, exports, and migrations.

Teamwork :

    Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into system configurations.

    Train team members on system features and best practices.

    Write clear documentation for configurations and procedures.

    Proactively suggest improvements to tools and processes.



Profile

What Matters Most :

    Genuine curiosity: you enjoy figuring out how systems work.

    Problem-solving mindset: you dig until you find the root cause, not just the quick fix.

    Fast learner: comfortable picking up new tools and platforms independently.

    Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

Required Skills :

    Professional working proficiency in French, English, and German (or Luxembourgish).

    Ability to troubleshoot issues methodically and document solutions.

    Basic understanding of how applications store and organize data.

    Strong written communication skills for support responses and documentation.

Nice to Have :

    Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

    Basic scripting or automation knowledge/interest (JavaScript, Python, or no-code tools like Zapier/Make).

    Familiarity with APIs or system integrations.

    Background in IT support, helpdesk, or technical support.

    Understanding of SQL or database concepts.

Soft Skills

    Strong sense of ownership for system reliability and user satisfaction.

    Clear and helpful communication style.

    Self-management skills: ability to prioritize tickets and projects independently.

    Collaborative mindset and willingness to assist team members.

    Proactive approach to identifying and fixing recurring problems.

• Validate Request Fulfillment on our IT ticketing tools.

description:
Consultant(e) – Manager Risk & Finance (H/F)

Qui sommes-nous ?

Finegan Luxembourg fait partie du groupe Finegan, un cabinet de conseil français indépendant fondé en 2009. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations en favorisant innovation, proximité et engagement à long terme.
Nous valorisons le travail collectif et soutenons nos consultants dans leur développement professionnel tout en respectant nos engagements sociétaux.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Manager Risk & Finance disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des risques et en finance, ainsi que d'une forte appétence pour le développement commercial et le management d'équipes.

Vos missions principales :

En tant que Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de nos activités et l'accompagnement de nos clients du secteur financier.
À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Développer et consolider un portefeuille de clients au sein des secteurs bancaires, assurance et fonds d'investissement.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et contribuer activement à la croissance du cabinet.
• Piloter des missions de conseil en gestion des risques financiers, prudentiels et opérationnels.
• Accompagner les clients dans leurs problématiques de finance, de réglementation et de transformation.
• Encadrer, animer et faire monter en compétences des équipes de consultants et d'analystes.
• Assurer le suivi des missions, la qualité des livrables et la satisfaction des clients.
• Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et à la construction des offres de services.
• Contribuer à la réflexion stratégique et au développement des activités de Finegan Luxembourg.
• Assurer une veille réglementaire et sectorielle afin d'accompagner les clients dans l'évolution de leurs dispositifs de gestion des risques et de conformité.

Profil recherché :

• Diplôme de niveau Master en Finance, Statistiques, Mathématiques appliquées, Économie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée en gestion des risques et finance acquise au sein d'un cabinet de conseil, d'une banque, d'une compagnie d'assurance ou d'un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Expérience significative dans la conduite de projets et l'accompagnement de transformations réglementaires.
• Solide expérience en management d'équipe et en encadrement de consultants.
• Forte sensibilité commerciale et goût pour le développement de relations clients durables.
• Excellente compréhension des enjeux actuels du secteur financier luxembourgeois et européen.

Compétences techniques

Gestion des risques

• Modélisation et validation des paramètres réglementaires (PD, LGD, EAD).
• Maîtrise des dispositifs de gestion des risques de crédit, de marché et opérationne
• Connaissance approfondie des méthodologies quantitatives appliquées au risque.
• Maîtrise des processus ICAAP, stress testing et dispositifs prudentiels.

Réglementation bancaire et prudentielle

• Bâle III / Bâle IV.
• CRD / CRR.
• Dispositifs de conformité et de gouvernance des risques.

description:

About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

title: Chef de Rang (m/f)
description:
Description:

Fiche de poste

Responsable d'un rang, c'est-à-dire d'un groupe de tables, le chef de rang doit veiller au bon déroulement du service sur l'ensemble de ces tables.

En cas d'absence du maître d'hôtel prise de commande le chef de rang fait le service à table et débarrassé aidé par des commis.

Lors de la mise en place des tables, il vérifie que rien ne manque; au moment du service, il doit parfaitement bien connaître la carte et les plats pour être en mesure de répondre aux questions des clients, connaître, maîtriser toutes les techniques de présentation et de découpage, voire de flambage.

À la fin du repas, il s'assure de la satisfaction des clients, effectue l'addition et encaisse leur règlement.

Activités principales

• Assurer un excellent service
• Relations avec la clientèle
• Mise en place
• Accueil et accompagnement du client
• Prise de commande et service
• Encadrer le travail des commis

Coordination et contrôle

• effectuer la mise en place des tables avant chaque service,
• vérifier la propreté et l'intégrité de la vaisselle et des couverts,
• mettre en place les consoles de service,
• accueillir et accompagner le client jusqu'à sa table,
• présenter la carte et la carte des vins (en cas d'absence du sommelier)
• prendre la commande et la transmettre à la cuisine,
• connaître parfaitement les plats à la carte ainsi que les éventuels plats du jour,
• expliquer aux clients la composition des plats au moment du service,
• répondre aux questions des clients,
• maîtriser les différentes techniques de découpage et de présentation,
• adapter le service à table en fonction du travail des cuisiniers,
• vérifier le bon déroulement du service,
• encadrer le travail des commis de salle et des serveurs,
• s'enquérir de la satisfaction du client au cours et à la fin du repas,
• éditer l'addition,
• réaliser l'encaissement,
• débarrasser les tables.

Compétences principales

• Analyser rapidement le besoin du client et le conseiller dans ses choix
• Gérer les réclamations et les remarques négatives
• Adopter les gestes et postures permettant de travailler en toute sécurité
• Placer le client au centre de son activité et de sa mission
• Connaissance d'une à plusieurs langues étrangères

Savoir Etre

• Accueillir les clients avec une excellente maîtrise des gestes, de l'expression du visage et du langage
• Adapter son comportement, sa présentation générale à l'image et à la culture de l'établissement
• Assurer la cohésion de l'équipe
• Faire reconnaître et accepter son autorité
• Installer dès la réservation un climat de convivialité en appliquant les codes de l'établissement
• Relever les dysfonctionnements de service et en parler hors présence client

Autres avantages:  Parking, Repas.

The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. • Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.

• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.

title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. title: GIO - Application Administrator / Support Engineer (m/f)
description:
We are looking for an Application Administrator / Support Engineer to take ownership of our business systems and provide second-level support to users across the organization. You will configure and maintain business applications, resolve escalated support issues, manage user access, build reports and automations, and ensure our tools run smoothly as we grow.


This role offers growth opportunities with hands-on experience in system integrations, automation, and technical operations. You will start as a power user and develop into a technical administrator who builds workflows and connects systems.


Responsibilities
Second-Level Support :

    Handle escalated support tickets requiring deeper technical investigation.

    Diagnose and resolve complex application issues across business systems.

    Communicate solutions clearly to users in French, English, and German.

    Document recurring issues and create knowledge base articles.

    Identify patterns in support requests and address root causes.

User & Access Management :

    Manage user accounts, permissions, and roles across all business applications.

    Own onboarding and offboarding processes for system access.

    Configure applications to match business processes and workflows.

    Set up and maintain integrations between systems.

Data & Reporting :

    Create and maintain reports and dashboards that support decision-making.

    Ensure data quality and consistency across platforms.

    Handle data imports, exports, and migrations.

Teamwork :

    Gather requirements from stakeholders and translate them into system configurations.

    Train team members on system features and best practices.

    Write clear documentation for configurations and procedures.

    Proactively suggest improvements to tools and processes.



Profile

What Matters Most :

    Genuine curiosity: you enjoy figuring out how systems work.

    Problem-solving mindset: you dig until you find the root cause, not just the quick fix.

    Fast learner: comfortable picking up new tools and platforms independently.

    Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

Required Skills :

    Professional working proficiency in French, English, and German (or Luxembourgish).

    Ability to troubleshoot issues methodically and document solutions.

    Basic understanding of how applications store and organize data.

    Strong written communication skills for support responses and documentation.

Nice to Have :

    Experience administering Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms.

    Basic scripting or automation knowledge/interest (JavaScript, Python, or no-code tools like Zapier/Make).

    Familiarity with APIs or system integrations.

    Background in IT support, helpdesk, or technical support.

    Understanding of SQL or database concepts.

Soft Skills

    Strong sense of ownership for system reliability and user satisfaction.

    Clear and helpful communication style.

    Self-management skills: ability to prioritize tickets and projects independently.

    Collaborative mindset and willingness to assist team members.

    Proactive approach to identifying and fixing recurring problems.

title: Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department (m/f) – CDI
description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;
• Participate in ICT and security projects;
• Adopting a growth mind-set, promoting a culture of security;
• Excellent team player with proactive and autonomous work ethics;
• Strong analytical skills with attention to details;
• Awareness of professional ethics, risk and compliance;
• Fluent in English

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

You will build relationships, shape governance routines, and help ensure critical deliverables are tracked and closed with discipline.

• Maintain the single source of truth for AML matters, including the JPMSE AML Areas of Concern and the Issue/Action Register, ensuring clear ownership, target dates, dependencies, and documented closure evidence/status.
• Identify, triage, and track emerging AML risks/issues (1LoD lens), prepare concise escalation summaries, and monitor escalations through to closure in line with agreed governance.
• Support the coordination and quality-check regulatory RFIs end-to-end (intake, scoping, stakeholder outreach, drafting coordination, and evidence collation) and produce final response packs for AML 1LoD Lead review and sign-off.

• Coordinate the AMLA data questionnaire by managing inputs, challenge/validation, tracking, evidence collation, and final pack preparation for sign-off.
• Support AML New Product Assessment activities by coordinating required inputs, tracking actions, and preparing evidence/assessment materials for AML 1LoD Lead review.
• Support regulatory strategy and change monitoring by tracking regulatory change and industry developments impacting JPMSE; maintaining a regulatory change/watch-items tracker (aligned with 2LoD) with actions, owners, and dates; and reporting progress on a regular cadence.
