title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

title: Join our Account Executive teams!
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Glassmontør søkes til Glassmester1
description:

Vil du jobbe med varierte glassprosjekter i et solid og faglig sterkt miljø?

Glassmester1 har økende aktivitet og søker nå en dyktig glassmontør som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag med både små og større oppdrag.

Glassmester1 er et av Norges ledende selskaper innen glassfaget. Hos oss blir du en del av et godt fagmiljø der kvalitet, selvstendighet og gode løsninger står sentralt.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Montering og utskifting av glass, isolerruter, speil, dusjløsninger, glassrekkverk, glassvegger og dører

  • Oppmåling og vurdering av gode og praktiske montasjeløsninger
  • Dokumentasjon av utført arbeid gjennom bilder, avvik og rapportering
  • Bruk av digitale systemer for HMS, timeregistrering, dokumentasjon, FDV og prosjektoppfølging
  • Praktiske oppgaver knyttet til daglig drift, utstyr, servicebil, lager og verksted
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser gjerne at du har fagbrev innen glassfaget eller annen relevant håndverksbakgrunn. Relevant og dokumenterbar erfaring kan kompensere for manglende fagbrev.

Du har gjerne erfaring fra glassfaget, byggebransjen, fasadearbeid, vindu- og dørmontasje eller tilsvarende praktisk håndverksarbeid.

I tillegg ønsker vi at du:

  • Har førerkort klasse B
  • Behersker norsk/skandinavisk eller engelsk

Du er nøyaktig og kvalitetsbevisst og liker å finne gode løsninger ute på oppdrag. Du tar ansvar for jobben du gjør og møter både kunder og kollegaer på en profesjonell og positiv måte.

  • En variert arbeidshverdag med spennende prosjekter
  • Gode kollegaer og et uformelt arbeidsmiljø
  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Moderne verktøy, digitale systemer og servicebiler

title: Head of Software Engineering
description:
About Monil

Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we've grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars deployed across multiple markets, and we are now entering a new phase of international growth with rapid expansion into the US.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication, but the value our customers experience lives in the software: the cloud platform, the data pipelines that turn raw device telemetry into insight, and the apps farmers use every day to control and understand their herds in real time.

We're looking for a Head of Software Engineering to own and scale that software, and to build the team and technical foundations that will carry us through international expansion.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with full ownership of our software engineering function across frontend, backend, and data. You will set technical direction, build and grow the team, and be accountable for the quality, reliability, and velocity of everything we ship above the device layer. The role is part of Monil’s management team and will be crucial to guide the company in a rapid growth phase.

You will collaborate closely with our product and hardware teams. Your effectiveness will depend as much on strong, trust-based collaboration with those teams as on your technical leadership. Product owns the what and the why; Hardware owns the device. You own the how and the when for all software and data products, and you are the connective tissue that turns device capability and product intent into reliable, shipped systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of Monil's software platform across frontend, backend, and data.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organisation: hiring, mentoring, structuring teams, and setting the technical and cultural bar.

  • Define and drive software engineering standards, and technical best practices across the platform, including CI/CD, testing, observability, and on-call/reliability practices.

  • Build the data foundation that turns high-volume telemetry into reliable, queryable, and actionable data. Ensure that all models are productionised, platform-integrated, and maintained to the same high standards as the rest of the systems.

  • Partner closely with Product to translate roadmaps into deliverable, well-sequenced engineering plans, and to make pragmatic trade-offs on scope, timing, and technical investment.

  • Partner closely with R&D on the device-to-cloud boundary, telemetry contracts, device management, and OTA: ensuring software and firmware evolve coherently.

  • Own delivery: balance feature velocity against the architectural and operational work needed to scale internationally and reliably.

  • Be accountable for software quality, security, and the production reliability of customer-facing systems.

We believe you have

  • Significant experience leading software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale.

  • Strong technical depth across at least one of frontend, backend, or data engineering, and the breadth and credibility to lead all three.

  • Experience with modern backend and cloud architectures, distributed systems, and the data infrastructure behind high-volume telemetry or IoT-style workloads.

  • A solid grasp of modern engineering practices; CI/CD, automated testing, observability.

  • Experience working alongside product and hardware functions, and a genuine ability to drive outcomes through influence and collaboration rather than authority alone.

  • Strong people leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining engineers, and building team structures that scale.

Experience with any of the following is a plus: connected/IoT systems and device-to-cloud data flows; edge or on-device ML; low-power or connectivity-constrained system design; OTA and device management at scale.

We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments.

  • Comfortable owning outcomes end to end and driving them from idea to production.

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering and organisational challenges.

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams, and who builds trust with peer leaders in Product and Hardware.

  • Able to hold a high quality and reliability bar while keeping the team moving fast in an engaging way.

We offer

  • Full ownership of a software function during a period of rapid international growth.

  • Challenging engineering problems spanning connected devices, large-scale data, and customer-facing applications.

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities.

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Some travel might be required.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

title: Internship Data Engineer
description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer Intern at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior Data Engineer, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets, ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in collaboration with diverse teams.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow within a dynamic startup environment.
What We Offer:
  • Mentorship and growth opportunities working directly with our Senior Data Engineer and exposure to industry leaders like Simula.
  • Work on cutting-edge projects in the EV charging infrastructure and green energy space.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class partners like the European Space Agency and EIT Urban Mobility.
  • A vibrant, innovative startup environment with flexible working hours at our office in StartupLab in Oslo.
  • Be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to bold innovation, sustainability, and creating positive environmental impact.
Preferred Location:

We prefer candidates based in Oslo, but we are open to remote positions for the right candidate.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

title: Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee?
description:
Are you an engineer with a passion for coffee? Help us design and build the future of roasting technology.

ROEST is revolutionizing the coffee industry with advanced roasting technology designed and built in Norway. Our team of passionate coffee experts, engineers, and designers work together to create innovative solutions that empower roasters worldwide. We're driven by a commitment to quality, consistency, and sustainability, helping coffee professionals achieve perfect roasts every time. Join us on our mission to make (even) better coffee!

The Opportunity

Are you a visionary Senior Product Development Engineer eager to lead transformative projects and shape the future of coffee technology? At ROEST we are redefining the art and science of roasting with advanced Norwegian-engineered technology. We offer an opportunity to lead significant product initiatives and thrive within a collaborative, innovative culture that values your expertise.

Your Impact at ROEST

As a Product Development Engineer at ROEST, you won't just be designing parts; you'll be shaping the experience for thousands of coffee professionals worldwide. You will be a vital part of a dedicated team where your ideas have a direct and immediate impact on the final product. We're looking for someone who is hands-on, creative, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

What You'll Be Doing

This is a hands-on role where you'll be involved in every stage of development. Here's what you can expect to be working on:

  • Design, develop, and test a game-changing new electrical coffee roaster. Project start Q3 2026.

  • Create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using Solidworks (or other tools) for prototyping and manufacturing.

  • Collaborate directly with the production team to implement and refine DFM/A principles.

  • Build and validate physical prototypes to rigorously test new concepts and technologies.

  • Participate in the full product lifecycle, from initial ideation and sketching to mass production and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leading the design, development, and validation of new hardware products.

  • Optimizing existing product lines for performance, cost, and reliability.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (production, customer support, R&D).

  • Researching and integrating new technologies and engineering solutions.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Master's degree in product development or 7+ years of industrial experience

  • Proven experience leading products from concept to launch.

  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex engineering problems.

  • Proven experience in product development, from concept to production.

  • High proficiency in 3D CAD software

  • Strong understanding of DFM/A (Design for Manufacturing/Assembly) principles.

  • Experience applying project management methodologies in a development context.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience

  • Experience with Computational fluid dynamics to solve complex tasks.

  • Experience with thermal management simulation and design.

  • Prior experience in the coffee industry or with food processing equipment.

  • Leadership experience or mentorship of junior engineers.

  • Understanding of electrical engineering principles for product integration.

  • A genuine passion for coffee and the technology that perfects it.

  • Highly motivated and comfortable working both independently and in a team.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work with cross-functional teams.

  • An innovative mindset, always curious and looking for better solutions.

Work Arrangement & Location

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Oslo, Norway.

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. In 2023 we will launch a new production roaster for small to medium-sized roasteries. Since 2018 we have sold over 1000 roasters to more than 80 countries around the world. Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

Full-cycle recruitment

Alongside this, you'll partner with hiring managers to understand what they need and advise on candidate market insight, keep candidates engaged throughout the process, and craft and post job ads on relevant job boards.

What You Bring

  • 2–3 years in talent acquisition, recruitment, or proactive sourcing, with a genuine track record of engaging passive candidates

  • Fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS tools, and curious about using AI to work smarter

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required; working proficiency in German is an advantage

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Culture — Why You'll Love It Here

We're a Scandinavian company with a high-performance, caring culture. We set the bar high, and we back each other to get there.

  • Purpose with scale: You won't just be sourcing for any company — your work directly fuels a mission that keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included

  • Big impact, real ownership: This is a scale-up, not a corporate machine. We start from a place of trust, so you'll have real ownership of your work from day one, with support from a highly experienced team

Please click APPLY and upload your CV in English, and record a short video in English outlining your motivation and letting your personality shine through.

📍 Remote, based in Poland.

We're unable to sponsor visas or work permits. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Poland (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residency, or an existing valid work permit).

title: CEO
description:
CEO, Seidr Technologies

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection for energy-intensive industrial projects into hours of automated analysis. This is solving a significant bottleneck in a rapidly growing market. We have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline across Power-to-X and data center developers in the Nordics and Germany. Read more about what we do on our company profile.


The role

We're looking for a CEO to lead Seidr forward and be the face of the company to investors, customers and partners. You'll own recruiting and team-building together with our venture studio REspire and our CTO Aman, and take on the full range of responsibilities that come with leading an early-stage startup.

Aman leads product and engineering, and we'll be growing the tech team further over time. Your main day-to-day focus will be commercial: direct, outbound sales to developers of energy-intensive projects, alongside shaping the business model and pricing as we move from pilot to scale.


What we're looking for

Above all, someone who wants to build a startup and understands what that actually takes: grit, resourcefulness, and the ability to move fast with limited resources. Previous startup experience is a strong signal of this, but not the only way to show it.

You should have solid experience in business development and B2B sales. Experience from data center development, or development of other power-intensive industry (Power-to-X, renewables, heavy industry), is a strong plus.


Location & setup

We'd prefer someone based in Norway who can work from our office in Asker, but we're open to strong candidates based elsewhere. We're also open to starting part-time and ramping up as the company grows.


A note on stage and risk

This is a pre-seed startup, not a conventional job. Until we close funding, which you'll be directly involved in raising, there is no fixed salary. We're open to pragmatic solutions along the way, such as a part-time period, but you should go into this with your eyes open and a genuine appetite for that kind of risk.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection and early-phase engineering work into hours of automated analysis, for developers of energy-intensive industrial projects: Power-to-X, data centers, and other power-hungry industries across Europe. Today, finding and qualifying a site for one of these projects takes 6-18 months and can cost millions, because the work is done manually, spreadsheet by spreadsheet, consultant by consultant, one candidate site at a time. Critical blockers, such as insufficient grid capacity or zoning conflicts, often surface only after months of work, when changing course is expensive. Seidr automates this. Our platform screens candidate sites in parallel against dozens of criteria, including grid capacity, current and future zoning, and environmental risk, and returns a ranked, decision-ready shortlist in hours instead of months. The underlying logic is built on real industrial project experience, not generic AI. We already have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline of Power-to-X and data center developers across the Nordics and Germany. Backed by a venture studio, we are now looking for a CEO to take Seidr from pilot to scale, and to grow the platform from site selection into the full early-phase planning stack for energy-intensive projects.

title: AI Integration Engineer
description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity — AI Integration Engineer

This is a new role at No Isolation, and you'd be the first person in it.

You'll sit inside Engineering but work mostly embedded inside selected internal business units, in contrast to the rest of Engineering. You’ll work with Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. You’ll connect the tools they depend on and implement AI tools and automation flows to positively impact our revenue first and foremost, but also generally enhance internal effectiveness.

In practice: you set the bar for how much internal AI and Automation can change the company from the inside in 2026 and beyond, and you co-own the stack you put in place. You will have a lot of direct contact with the teams you're building for, and a lot of say in how the technical side gets structured to enable you, while having the support of experienced software engineers when needed.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Systems integration: Drive automation of key business areas and connect our business tools across Data, IAM, CRM, ERP (Odoo) and Finance through APIs, webhooks and events, so data stays in sync across systems.

  • Internal automation capability: Build and maintain workflows in Windmill and/or n8n; migrate us off legacy SaaS and iPaaS tools as you go. Aim to articulate as many problems as possible as deterministic automations that keep data and AI cost low.

  • Internal AI capability: Contribute to shared infrastructure for using AI internally alongside our cloud/platform engineers: assistants, retrieval over internal knowledge, summarisation, classification, routing, etc. Turn ad hoc AI experiments into tools people can actually rely on, with eval sets in place to catch regressions.

  • Data & internal foundations: Centralise data into sources the business can trust, reconcile figures across systems so numbers match wherever they appear, and provide internal tools and lightly-built apps.

  • Guardrails & cost control: Define the standards for how integrations and AI get built here. Keep the set of automation platforms small and deliberate (e.g. Windmill, n8n and some custom). Track AI spend and return on investment so we can monitor alignment between the two.

  • Partnership: Work directly with the teams you're building for: understand the actual problem, ship a working increment near-instantly, then iterate and negotiate toward durability. You're measured on time saved, additional revenue generated, budget synergies realised, not on the tools you ship. Share knowledge and lift others through e.g. workshops and townhalls.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Talent for working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning a fuzzy request into a concrete system. This is a first-of-its-kind role here, so you're setting direction rather than following an existing playbook.

  • Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks and events: ERPs (Odoo v18 and beyond is a plus), CRMs, or Finance systems. At ease with various application protocols (REST), auth flows (OAuth/SSO) and the rough edges of third-party SaaS APIs.

  • Hands-on with a code-first orchestration platform: Windmill, Temporal, Airflow, n8n or similar.

  • A builder who finishes: Proficient in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go), and comfortable taking something from rough prototype (built by you or non-technical people) to engineering standard.

  • Comfortable using and configuring self-hosted tooling (containers, secrets, backups, upgrades) to some extent, as opposed to fully leaning on managed SaaS

  • Practical experience with LLMs and agents: context engineering, RAG, evals, tool/function calling. You should have a good sense of where AI helps and where it adds fragility.

  • Data sense: savvy with SQL and common data stores; able to model, reconcile and centralize data; some exposure to classical machine learning can be an advantage.

  • Security-conscious by default: least-privilege access, careful handling of secrets, aware of GDPR, SOC and ISO requirements.

  • STEM degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent practical experience in integration, AI & automation, or internal tooling.

  • Experience at product or scale-up companies is an advantage.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • First-of-its-kind role: you will tackle opportunities unexplored so far at the company

  • Purpose with scale: The systems you build free up time that goes straight back into helping educators support thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day.

  • Work with exceptional leaders: You'll report to our Director of Engineering, Jerome, with plenty of room to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture.

  • Growth through ownership: A lean environment with the freedom to propose what you think is best for our very company.

  • Stability with a lean size: We are profitable and growing rapidly, while keeping at a size where the ideal candidate will have high impact.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00–15:00), with a hybrid work schedule.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel and accident insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription reimbursement.

  • Regular company socials and an annual trip away together.

Our Tech Stack

Think internal tools, fleets of connected robots, and the systems that keep Sales, Finance and Customer Success running. You'll work with:

  • Orchestration & automation: Windmill, n8n

  • Languages: Go, Python, TypeScript

  • Systems: Odoo, HubSpot, and the wider CRM/finance/IAM stack

  • AI: LLMs and agents, RAG/retrieval, MCP, evaluation tooling

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, containers

  • Data: SQL, MySQL, ClickHouse

  • Development: GitLab, Claude Code and handful of other solutions being evaluated

Location

This role is based in Oslo with hybrid flexibility at our headquarters (up to 2 days remote work per week).

We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can progress candidates already in Norway or relocating with no need for additional work permit (such as the EU/EEA citizens). (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required).

How to Apply

If you like building things that make everyone else's work easier, are passionate about AI, and want that to matter for something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you'd like, you can also include a short video as part of your application — this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV.

🎥 You may watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You may explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Part-time Driver

description:

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45 or 06.00-14:00

A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. title: Fullstack-utvikler / AI-utvikler – arbeidstrening eller praksis i B2B/industri-startup
description:
Company: RoboConnect

Location: Molde, Norway

Work type: Full-time or part-time

Role type: Internship / student / junior developer / work training

Salary: Unpaid in the initial phase

Long-term possibility: Paid role may become possible if RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or a suitable commercial basis

Short description

RoboConnect is building an AI-supported B2B platform that helps industrial companies clarify automation needs before they invest in robotics, automation or system integration.

We are looking for a locally based fullstack developer who wants hands-on startup experience and can contribute to the development of RoboConnect’s platform, AI Advisor and internal tools. This is not a co-founder role and not an ordinary paid position at this stage, but it may become a paid role later if the collaboration works well and the company develops commercially.

About RoboConnect

Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what information is missing, whether the process is ready for investment, and which suppliers they should involve.

RoboConnect helps companies move from an unclear automation need to a structured and decision-relevant basis for internal decisions and supplier dialogue. The platform combines industrial automation insight, structured project data, AI-supported needs clarification, project preparation and matching with relevant automation partners.

The first focus area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. We are currently preparing customer pilots and further development of the MVP.

Why we need a developer in-house

RoboConnect is moving from concept and market validation into product development, pilots and technical iteration. We need stronger internal technical capacity, especially around the AI Advisor, frontend, backend, API integrations, data structure and user flows.

The current platform and AI work involves several moving parts, including customer registration, project forms, dashboards, structured project data, AI-assisted needs clarification, report generation and matching logic.

We are therefore looking for a developer who can work closely with the founder and contribute practically to building, improving and testing the product.

A local candidate in Molde or nearby is strongly preferred, because close collaboration, product discussions and faster iteration will be important. Some remote work may be possible, but we would like in-person collaboration several days per week.

What you will work on

You will contribute to practical product development for RoboConnect, including:

  • frontend development and user interface improvements

  • backend development and API integrations

  • AI Advisor / chatbot functionality for needs clarification

  • structured data capture from customer conversations or forms

  • database structure and data handling

  • dashboards for customers, suppliers and admin users

  • GitHub workflow, documentation and testing

  • improving user flows from registration to project clarification

  • preparing technical demos for pilots and customer feedback

The first tasks will be scoped clearly. The goal is not to build everything at once, but to make focused improvements that can be tested with real users.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with some practical development experience who wants to build real software in an early-stage startup.

You should have experience with, or strong interest in:

  • fullstack development

  • frontend and backend development

  • JavaScript / TypeScript

  • React / Next.js

  • APIs

  • databases

  • GitHub

  • AI tools, LLMs or chatbot development

  • structured problem solving

  • building usable products, not only experimenting with technology

Experience with Tailwind, Supabase, Convex, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar tools is an advantage, but not required if you learn quickly.

You do not need to be senior, but you should have built something before and be able to work independently on defined tasks.

You must be comfortable with

  • working in a very early-stage startup

  • incomplete systems and changing priorities

  • documenting your work clearly

  • committing code regularly to RoboConnect’s GitHub repository

  • working with agreed scope and delivery expectations

  • discussing technical choices openly

  • asking questions when something is unclear

  • receiving feedback and improving the solution iteratively

You must not commit API keys, passwords or secrets to GitHub. Production data and production credentials will not be shared during an initial trial period.

Language and location

Norwegian language skills are strongly preferred, because RoboConnect works with Norwegian industrial companies and customer needs must be understood clearly.

Candidates who speak English may also be considered if they are willing to learn Norwegian and can collaborate effectively in Norway.

The ideal candidate is located in Molde or within commuting distance. Candidates who can be physically present in Molde several days per week will be prioritized.

Practical setup

This is initially intended as an unpaid work-training, internship or experience-based role, depending on the candidate’s situation.

It may be especially relevant for someone who:

  • wants more practical experience in fullstack development

  • wants to build real startup/product experience

  • has completed studies, courses or self-learning but needs real project experience

  • is registered with NAV and may be eligible for work training or similar arrangements

  • wants to build a portfolio with meaningful product work

  • is interested in AI, automation, industrial technology or B2B platforms

RoboConnect will not present this as an ordinary paid employment relationship unless a separate paid agreement is made.

If the collaboration works well and RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or another commercial basis, a paid role may become possible later.

What you can gain

You will get hands-on experience with:

  • building a real B2B SaaS/AI platform

  • AI-supported product development

  • industrial automation use cases

  • customer needs clarification

  • startup product development

  • fullstack development in practice

  • GitHub, documentation, testing and deployment workflow

  • working close to the founder and team in an early-stage company

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants more than a theoretical project and wants to join in build something that may be used by real industrial companies.

About the founder

RoboConnect was founded by Elisabet Witsø. The company is based in Molde and connected to the industrial and automation ecosystem in Norway.

RoboConnect is still in an early phase, but has completed market validation, interviewed industrial companies and automation partners, completed MVP, and is preparing the next step toward pilots and commercial testing.

How to apply

Please apply through The Hub and answer the short application questions. Please also include your CV and GitHub profile.

The questions are intended to give us a better understanding of your motivation, availability, language skills, practical situation and how you work as a developer.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. title: Full-Stack Software Developer
description:
Full-Stack Software Developer

Oslo preferred | Remote possible for exceptional candidates | Full-time | Start as soon as possible

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers.

Real estate development teams still run some of their most important processes across Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, meetings and disconnected systems. Perlo brings that work into one place and helps project teams understand where they are, what requires attention and what they should do next.

We're a small, fast-moving team and are looking for a Full-Stack Software Developer who can take real ownership of the product.

This is not a role where you'll receive perfectly specified Jira tickets and implement them one by one.

You'll often get a problem, user need or desired outcome and be expected to understand it, propose a solution and ship it.

What you'll work on

You'll work across the Perlo product, including:

  • Building new product functionality from idea to production

  • Improving existing workflows and user experience

  • Working with project data, dashboards, reporting and AI-powered functionality

  • Designing database changes and backend logic

  • Building responsive interfaces in React / Next.js

  • Deploying and monitoring what you build

  • Fixing bugs and making pragmatic technical decisions

  • Using AI development tools extensively to move fast

Our current stack includes:

Next.js, React, TypeScript / JavaScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, TanStack, Tailwind CSS, Git, Git worktrees, Vercel and Claude Code.

You don't need to have worked professionally with every technology in the stack. We care much more about whether you can understand an existing codebase, solve problems and ship.

Who we're looking for

The most important thing is that you're autonomous.

You should be comfortable receiving direction like:

“Customers need a better way to understand what's changing across their projects.”

…and then working out what needs to happen technically to solve it.

You'll work closely with our CEO and the rest of the team, so you need to be able to translate non-technical product and business requirements into good technical solutions.

You are probably a good fit if you:

  • Can independently take a feature from problem → solution → production

  • Are comfortable making decisions when requirements aren't perfect

  • Ask good questions instead of waiting for detailed specifications

  • Are proactive and communicate clearly

  • Have solid JavaScript / TypeScript and web development fundamentals

  • Understand databases and relational data

  • Are comfortable working in an existing codebase

  • Use AI coding tools effectively rather than treating them as autocomplete

  • Care about shipping useful software, not engineering for engineering's sake

Experience with our exact stack is a bonus, not a requirement.

Location

We are based in Oslo, and we'd ideally like someone who can work with us in person at least some of the time.

That said, we are open to remote candidates if you're exceptionally strong, highly autonomous and a great fit for the way we work.

Why Perlo

We're still a small company, which means your work will have a very visible impact.

You'll get:

  • Significant ownership over a real production product

  • Direct access to customers and the problems we're solving

  • The ability to influence product and technical decisions

  • Very little bureaucracy

  • An AI-native development workflow

  • The opportunity to help shape the technical foundation of a growing B2B SaaS company

If you're the kind of developer who likes being given responsibility rather than tickets, we'd like to hear from you.

How to apply

Send us:

  1. A short introduction

  2. Your CV or LinkedIn

  3. Your GitHub, portfolio or something you've built, if you have one

  4. A few sentences about a product or feature you've built where you had significant ownership

We care much more about what you can do than writing a perfect application.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers. We help real estate development teams replace fragmented workflows across Excel, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint with one platform for project delivery, reporting and proactive decision-making. Perlo gives teams a clearer view of where projects stand, what requires attention, and what they should do next.

title: Driver
description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and Delivery Team Leaders on site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to stay fueled and energized.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Assessed on an ongoing basis

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • The position is based on a turnus schedule (rotational shift work)

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡


As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

Your responsibilities will include

  • Negotiate and manage complex contracts, including IP, data protection, and usage rights

  • Build and maintain an agile, high-performing preferred supplier ecosystem

  • Act as a strategic advisor to Marketing, Branding, Legal, Finance, and Compliance teams

  • Align sourcing efforts with business objectives, regulatory needs, and budgetary priorities

title: Shift Supervisor

description:
Your mission at Voi

As a Shift Supervisor you will be responsible for a team of Fleet Specialists in Oslo, overseeing operations while at the same time support them in their daily work. You will spend the majority of your time performing tasks in the warehouse and In field together with the team and the rest of the time for managerial duties such as planning, performance follow up, administrative tasks etc.

title: Overlege
description:
Om stillingen
Velkommen til oss!

Vi har ledig 100 % fast stilling som overlege i psykiatri i vårt allmennteam. LIS 3 i psykiatri i siste del av spesialisering, oppfordres til å søke.
Vi ser etter en faglig trygg og engasjert lege som ønsker å bidra til god pasientbehandling og videre utvikling av tilbudet vårt. Du har gode samarbeidsevner, trives i tverrfaglig arbeid og har interesse for kunnskapsbasert praksis.

Om allmennteamet
Poliklinikken har over tid arbeidet målrettet med å utvikle fagteam, og allmennteamet er i en spennende utviklingsfase. Vi ønsker å videreutvikle behandlingstilbudet til pasienter med stemningslidelser og pasienter som har opplevd psykose, og søker deg som har interesse for dette arbeidet.

Teamet består av psykiatere, LIS-leger, psykologspesialister, psykologer, spesialsykepleiere, IPS-jobbspesialister og erfaringskonsulenter. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle et sterkt fagmiljø i fellesskap, hvor teamfølelse, mestring og kollegial støtte er en forutsetning for å lykkes både faglig og som kolleger. I allmennteamet jobbes det blant annet ut ifra flere retninger innen kognitiv terapi, EMDR og generalistmodellen for personlighetsforstyrrelser. Allmennteamet følger mange pasienter gjennom hele behandlingsforløpet, samtidig som vi samarbeider tett med øvrige fagteam.
Dersom du ønsker det, legger vi godt til rette for at deler av stillingen kan knyttes til faglige utviklingsområder som traumer, spiseforstyrrelser, nevroutviklingsforstyrrelser, affektive lidelser, psykose og kunnskapsbaserte psykoterapimetoder. Dette gir gode muligheter for både fordypning og faglig bredde.

Om Arendal
Arendal er en sørlandsby med kort vei til sjø, natur og gode friluftsområder. Byen har et aktivt kultur- og fritidstilbud og er et attraktivt sted å bo og leve.

For alle kliniske stillinger må gyldig politiattest fremlegges før tiltredelse. Kravet gjelder ved ansettelse i henhold til gjeldende regelverk.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Som overlege eller LIS 3 vil du arbeide sammen med psykologer om utredning og behandling av et bredt spekter psykiske lidelser og medisinske avklaringer
  • Du vil bli en viktig del av et team hvor vi bruker hverandre aktivt til faglig drøfting, støtte og refleksjon. Tverrfaglig samarbeid er en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen
Personlige egenskaper
  • Vi ser etter deg som trives med klinisk arbeid og motiveres av å hjelpe pasienter med komplekse utfordringer
  • Du har gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter, evne til å skape tillit og bidrar til et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. For å trives hos oss må du være komfortabel med å arbeide selvstendig og sammen med andre kolleger
  • Vi tror du vil trives ekstra godt hos oss dersom du bringer med deg engasjement og litt letthet inn i arbeidshverdagen. Vi er opptatt av å ha det bra på jobb, og verdsetter kolleger som bidrar til både faglig kvalitet og et godt, levende arbeidsmiljø.
Vi tilbyr
  • Ved Østre Agder DPS legger vi til rette for fagutvikling, kompetanseheving og forskning
  • Vi har et aktivt fagmiljø hvor det er naturlig å dele erfaringer og utvikle praksis sammen. Medarbeidere oppfordres til å bidra inn i dette arbeidet.
  • Du vil bli en del av et kollegium med overleger, LIS-leger og andre faggrupper. Hverdagen er variert og til tider travel, men preget av godt samarbeid, tilgjengelige kolleger, et uformelt og godt arbeidsmiljø

Interessert?
Høres dette ut som noe for deg, er du velkommen til å ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat.

Mangfold og søknad

Vi ber alle søkere vedlegge dokumentasjon på utdanning, attester på arbeidserfaring og eventuelle spesialistgodkjenninger. Dette for å dokumentere kvalifikasjoner som kommer frem i CV, og til lønnsfastsettelse.

Sørlandet sykehus verdsetter mangfold og inkludering på arbeidsplassen. Vi mener at ulike perspektiver og erfaringer bidrar til å gi best mulig helsetjenester. Derfor oppfordrer vi alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonshemming, nasjonalitet, etnisk bakgrunn eller eventuelle opphold i arbeidslivet.

Sørlandet sykehus praktiserer meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25.

Kun elektroniske søknader vil bli vurdert.
